title: athyrium asplenioides var. subtripinnatum
intro: Athyrium asplenioides var. subtripinnatum, commonly known as Asplenium subtripinnatum, is a species of fern in the family Woodsiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in medicine to treat various health issues. It is said to have health benefits such as reducing inflammation and acting as an antioxidant, due to its therapeutic actions of anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and other phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
